original_test_intent: Measure platform memory latency, bandwidth under multiple read/write ratios, loaded latency and cache-to-cache behavior with Intel MLC and compare the complete result to the approved DIMM/platform performance specification.
original_method: Record DIMM part/population/speed/channels, CPU/socket/NUMA, BIOS/power/OS/kernel state and idle load; obtain an approved MLC archive/hash/license and compatibility guidance; preserve logs/telemetry plus current HugeTLB size/total/free/reserved and users; calculate/approve the4000-page reservation; set it temporarily; verify allocation; run the approved MLC profile with CPU/NUMA affinity/repetition; capture complete raw output and exit status; compare each approved metric to a versioned spec/tolerance under matching topology; restore original hugepage and any affinity/power state; verify memory, ECC, thermal and system health.
manual_activity: Performance/platform owner supplies the MLC artifact, compatibility, DIMM/NUMA profile, hugepage value and spec thresholds; agent may run and monitor the approved profile, restore state and calculate results.
required_inputs: DIMM PN/rank/capacity/speed/channel population and CPU/socket/NUMA topology
BIOS/memory/power profile, OS/kernel, idle-workload and thermal conditions
Approved Intel MLC version/archive/hash/license and target CPU/OS compatibility
Hugepage size/current state/consumers, memory headroom and approved temporary count
Versioned DIMM/platform spec with per-metric minimum/maximum, units, tolerance and repetitions
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT or approved maintenance window with memory/thermal/power monitoring
Do not download arbitrary latest artifacts or enter an unrestricted persistent root shell
Record hugepage size/state/consumers and calculate memory before setting4000
Stop on allocation failure, swap/OOM, ECC/hardware event, thermal/power limit or instability
Restore exact original HugeTLB/affinity/power state; no automatic rerun under changed profile
agent_execution_scope: Inventory topology/state, verify supplied artifact and compute hugepage impact
Apply the approved temporary setting, run/monitor MLC and capture full raw output
Restore state, verify health and compute approved metric comparisons
Do not choose tool/profile/spec, evict HugeTLB users, change BIOS/power/NUMA independently or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve hugepage reservation and maintenance conditions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broadly aligned but insufficient: it omits artifact/version, topology,4000-page privileged mutation, restoration, full metric schema and exact acceptance baseline; calling the run short is unsupported.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the verified archive/executable, record `Hugepagesize`, `HugePages_Total/Free/Rsvd/Surp` and original `vm.nr_hugepages`, set only the approved temporary count, run the exact approved `./mlc` profile with captured affinity/telemetry, then restore and verify the original state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Intel MLC3.10 example, Linux directory, root-required4000 hugepages, default `./mlc`, all example output classes, Common branch and30/15 minutes are preserved as source coverage, subject to approved equivalents.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run MLC as a controlled, topology-pinned benchmark with reversible HugeTLB reservation and machine-readable comparison of every approved output section.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact integrity, resource calculation, topology/affinity, repeatability, metric-level acceptance and restoration evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A full-looking MLC screen cannot be judged against `DIMM SPEC` without a comparable population/profile and explicit per-metric thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: 4000 pages may reserve very different memory depending on Hugepagesize; MLC on unsupported CPU/vendor or uncontrolled NUMA/power state can produce invalid results.

project_override_considerations: Do not assume Intel MLC is valid on a non-Intel CPU or that archive layout is always `Linux`. The sample values are examples, not thresholds. `match the DIMM SPEC` must be resolved to a platform-level metric matrix, since DIMM datasheets alone often do not define MLC outputs.
expected_evidence: DIMM/CPU/socket/NUMA/channel topology, BIOS/power/OS/kernel and idle-load state
MLC artifact version/path/hash/license and compatibility approval
Original/temporary/final HugeTLB fields, page size, calculated bytes, consumers and memory/swap headroom
Exact command/profile/affinity/repetition plus full raw idle, bandwidth-ratio, node, loaded-latency and cache-transfer output
Per-metric parsed values, units and comparison to versioned threshold/tolerance matrix
Thermal/power/ECC/log telemetry, restoration proof, final system health and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Turns an unbounded `match DIMM SPEC` judgment into a reproducible topology- and metric-specific benchmark while preserving every MLC output class and the source hugepage setup.
independent_technical_reasoning: MLC output reflects the whole CPU-memory subsystem, not only DIMM silicon: channel population, NUMA placement, memory frequency, power policy and background traffic materially change every metric. The4000 count is not a fixed byte quantity; it must be multiplied by Hugepagesize and checked against existing consumers and available memory. A single sample output cannot define PASS. Reproducible acceptance needs pinned conditions, repeated measurements and per-section thresholds, followed by exact HugeTLB restoration.
